title: A previous visit occurs earlier
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, and let $n,t,s$ be natural numbers and $\tau$ a work-tape index. If the last previous visit of tape $\tau$ at time $t$ on the all-zero input of length $n$ is $s$, then $s<t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
